result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but the 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar has overlapping metadata text that renders as unreadable garbled content. A minor styling inconsistency also exists between the favorite buttons on the two promoted cards.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar subtitle line renders overlapping strings ('25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' collide, producing '25–3 5 min delivery'), making the delivery time and fee illegible.
issues.suggestion: Lay the metadata out in a single flex row with proper gap/separator spacing and prevent absolute positioning or negative margins from stacking the two labels on top of each other.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling — the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' cards show only badges ('€0 delivery', '−20%') and image; the ramen card's rating row (4.8 (500+)) sits far right while the collided metadata below breaks visual hierarchy of the card footer.
issues.suggestion: Align the card footer as a two-column layout (name + metadata on the left, rating on the right) with consistent baseline spacing.
